caption: The drawing consists of a pencil sketch on a beige or lightly yellowed rectangular piece of paper with trimmed corners. The central object is a bonnet, depicted in profile, with its crown on the left and its brim facing right. The bonnet is rounded with horizontal, curved lines indicating gathered or layered fabric on the crown. The brim is wide, prominent, and framed with a decorative trim, which is illustrated with a textured, scalloped line suggesting ruffles or lace. Two long, textured ribbons are attached at the bottom, hanging down with visible folds and waving shapes, and are tied in bows at both the base of the bonnet and on top of the crown. The lines are fine and detailed, giving shape to fabric folds and decorative elements, with no coloration except for the natural pencil color against the paper background. The composition is contained and centered within the cut paper.
title: Cap
